description: AllMight chain registry. Venues, factories, and token-registry pointers per chain. Modify only with verified on-chain addresses. Validated by scripts/tools/validate_chain_config.js before any consumer reads.

camelot_v3.note: Algebra protocol — uses poolByPair() (no fee tier arg) and globalState() (returns dynamic fee). Factory address sourced from scripts/tools/multi_pair_pool_discovery.js line 233 (header comment in same file was truncated to 39 hex chars; corrected here).

ramses_v2.note: V2 in the name only — Ramses V2 CL uses slot0() like UniV3, not globalState(). Factory address sourced from scripts/tools/multi_pair_pool_discovery.js line 240 (with env-var override). Fee tiers are NON-STANDARD: confirmed-active [250, 500, 3000, 10000]; reverts on [50, 100, 2500].

aerodrome_v2.note: V2 constant-product (volatile + stable pools); use getReserves() not slot0(). Boss-verified 2026-05-30 (BaseScan); originally provided lowercase, normalized here to EIP-55 checksum form via ethers.getAddress().

aerodrome_slipstream.note: Slipstream V1 (Initial Deployment) PoolFactory. Source: aerodrome-finance/slipstream GitHub deployments table. CRITICAL: the previous value (0xeC8E5342...) is the PoolImplementation, NOT the factory — BaseScan's public name tag 'Aerodrome: SlipStream Pool Factory' is misleading; that address's source code shows Contract Name = CLPool. CLFactory.getPool(addr,addr,int24 tickSpacing) REVERTS for non-existent pools (unlike UniV3 which returns 0x0); discovery handles via slipstream_factory branch. feeTiers semantically holds tickSpacings for Slipstream (1, 50, 100, 200, 500, 2500, 10000). Verified pools (2026-05-30): ETH/USDC tickSpacing=1 at 0xdbc699...30f1 (fee 0.008%, real depth); tickSpacing=50 at 0xAaD23a...D517 (fee 0.05%, EMPTY). See docs/lessons/dex_contract_discovery_pitfalls.md.

velodrome_v2.note: Velodrome V2 PoolFactory — Solidly fork V2 AMM. Direct ancestor of Aerodrome V2 on Base (identical ABI). Reuses aerodrome_v2 dispatch type. getFee(*, false) confirmed = 30 raw = 30 bps volatile. Verified on-chain 2026-06-01.

velodrome_slipstream.note: Velodrome Slipstream V1 factory — direct ancestor of Aerodrome Slipstream on Base (identical ABI: 6-field slot0, getPool(addr,addr,int24)). Reuses slipstream dispatch type. Pools verified at ts=1 and ts=100 for native USDC. Alternate factory 0x548118C7... also live but skipped for initial integration; can be added in a follow-up if discovery shows deeper pools there.

velodrome_v2.note: Velodrome V2 PoolFactory — Solidly fork V2 AMM. Direct ancestor of Aerodrome V2 on Base (identical ABI). Reuses aerodrome_v2 dispatch type. getFee(*, false) confirmed = 30 raw = 30 bps volatile. Verified on-chain 2026-06-01.

shadow_v3.note: Shadow Exchange CL — Ramses V3 fork on Sonic. Per Shadow official docs (docs.shadow.so/pages/contract-addresses). Step 2 factory verification (wave8 commit 2 / a6e4852) CONFIRMED ABI = Ramses V3 family: getPool(address, address, int24 tickSpacing). NOT UniV3-compatible. feeTiers field semantically holds tickSpacings (same convention as slipstream venues): [1, 5, 10, 50, 100, 200] all confirmed with wS/USDC pools on-chain; ts=60 tested and confirmed empty (no pool). Dispatch reuses slipstream_factory factoryType (same int24 signature) but uses standard slot0 slotFn (Ramses V3 maintains UniV3 pool ABI, distinct from Slipstream's Solidly-derivative slot0_slipstream).

shadow_v2.note: Shadow Exchange V2 — Solidly fork on Sonic. Per Shadow official docs. Using aerodrome_v2 venue type because all Solidly forks share the getPool(tokenA, tokenB, stable) interface.

cleopatra_cl.note: Cleopatra CL factory — AUTHORIZED RAMSES V3 SISTER FORK on Mantle (BUSL-1.1 license from Ramses per docs.cleo.exchange). Source: docs.cleo.exchange/resources/deployed-contract-addresses (verified 2026-06-04). venue type 'ramses_v3' (introduced wave8 commit 3) — reuses slipstream_factory dispatch for int24 tickSpacing getPool, uses standard UniV3 slot0 for pool reads. feeTiers field semantically holds tickSpacings (same convention as slipstream + Sonic Shadow V3). Initial set [1,5,10,50,100,200] mirrors Sonic Shadow tickSpacing range; Step 2 factory verification will confirm which tickSpacings actually have wS/USDC and WMNT/USDC pools. Pattern 4 PRIMARY TEST TARGET — first chain where Ramses-family depth gate can actually be challenged (Sonic + Unichain both STRUCTURALLY_DEAD before reaching behavioral probe).

cleopatra_legacy.note: Cleopatra Legacy pairFactory — Solidly V2 fork (Ramses V2 sister fork lineage). Source: docs.cleo.exchange/resources/deployed-contract-addresses (verified 2026-06-04). Uses Solidly-legacy getPair(A, B, stable) ABI — discovery's aerodrome_v2 dispatch handles this via the getPair fallback landed in infra(discovery) commit 048b97d. Discovery will scan BOTH stable=false (volatile) and stable=true. THIS IS THE PATTERN 4 DEPTH GATE — if Cleopatra Legacy has Ramses-class depth (~\$5M+), the surface progresses to behavioral probe. If depth is dust (similar to Shadow V2 \$79 or Velo V2 \$88), Pattern 5 (modern chains skip V2) strengthens and Mantle joins Sonic/Unichain in the STRUCTURALLY_DEAD column.
